units.source_text: 但是我并不像这位诗人一样厌世。

en.t: But I am not world-weary like this poet.

units.source_text: 只要河童们愿意常常来看望一下我……

en.t: If only the kappa would be willing to come and see me from time to time...

units.source_text: 对了，我忘记说了，你还记得我那位审判官朋友——河童培卟吧？

en.t: Oh yes, I forgot to mention it. You remember my judge friend, the kappa Peppu, don't you?
After he lost his job, he truly went mad.

units.source_text: 据说现在正住在河童国的精神病院里。

en.t: They say he is now living in a mental hospital in the land of the kappa.

units.source_text: 倘若S博士同意的话，我很想去探望他呢……

en.t: If Dr. S agrees, I would very much like to go and visit him...
